teaser.en: A rarely seen shrub of the coastal forest understorey, related to the ironwoods.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kisichoonekana mara nyingi cha sehemu ya chini ya msitu wa pwani, jamaa wa miti ya ironwood.

summary.en: *Chitambuu* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey with stiff, leathery leaves. Pakia records the name but no uses.
summary.sw: *Chitambuu* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini ya msitu, wenye majani magumu kama ngozi yasiyopinda kwa urahisi. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi yoyote.

about.en: *Memecylon amaniense* (also placed in *Warneckea*, as *W. amaniensis*) is an evergreen shrub or small tree. It has stiff, smooth, leathery leaves in opposite pairs, small bluish-purple or white flowers in clusters, and small fleshy berries. Members of this group are typical of the shaded understorey of East African coastal and lowland forests.
about.sw: *Memecylon amaniense* (ambao pia huwekwa katika *Warneckea*, kama *W. amaniensis*) ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa kijani mwaka mzima. Una majani magumu, laini, kama ngozi, katika jozi zinazoelekeana, maua madogo ya rangi ya buluu-zambarau au meupe katika vishada, na beri ndogo zenye nyama. Mimea ya kundi hili ni ya kawaida katika sehemu ya chini yenye kivuli ya misitu ya pwani na ya nyanda za chini ya Afrika Mashariki.

where.en: It grows in forest in eastern Africa. The species is named after Amani in Tanzania's East Usambara mountains.
where.sw: Huota msituni mashariki mwa Afrika. Spishi hii imepewa jina la Amani katika milima ya Usambara Mashariki nchini Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chitambuu* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded. Its relative *Memecylon sansibaricum* is called *mvamva wa tsakani*.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chitambuu* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Jamaa yake *Memecylon sansibaricum* huitwa *mvamva wa tsakani*.

reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha sehemu ya chini ya msitu
